newsitem.title: USA: KTI Inc acquires Manner Resin.
newsitem.headline: KTI Inc acquires Manner Resin.

text.p: KTI Inc said on Wednesday that it acquired Manner Resin Inc, a Maryland-based broker of recycled plastics, for 65,000 shares in KTI stock as well as incentive options to Manner's key personnel.
KTI said in a release on Wednesday that Manner employs seven people and generates about $5 million in current annual revenues.
The company said Manner will help the consolidation of KTI's recently acquired plastic recycling plant, Timber Plastic Recycling Inc in Tuscaloosa, Alabama.
